There’s no way I would ever do that.
DAK is crazy and I bet he doesn’t even have a plan.
He just wants to take over Admin’s organization to boost his fragile ego.
No terrorist ever got what he wanted, this isn’t the way to change the world.
Big Daddy for example. He wants to change people’s opinion on bots and AI and make a difference in a peaceful manner.
It might take time, but I’m sure that in the end it will be successful.
Even Admin’s goal is more feasible.
A powerful AI has a better chance at taking over a country than a bunch of nutjobs with guns. It should be obvious.
Of course, Admin firstly needs to actually create such an AI and if that is even possible is a completely different matter.
Anyway, I have no time to think about this. If I don’t go now, I might be late for the meeting…
